title: Microsoft offers laid-off employees generous package
title_zh: 微软为下岗员工提供丰厚福利
summary: Tech layoff announcements follow a predictable script. A company memo goes out. The number of jobs cut makes the headlines. Executives talk about realigning for the future.
summary_zh: 技术裁员公告遵循可预测的脚本。一份公司备忘录发出了。裁员数量成为头条新闻。高管们谈论未来的调整。

title: $35 Billion AI Credit Deal Nears Trading as Broadcom Financing Advances
title_zh: 随着博通融资的推进，350 亿美元的人工智能信贷交易即将完成交易
summary: About $15 billion of the AI infrastructure financing could become tradable by early next year.
summary_zh: 到明年初，大约 150 亿美元的人工智能基础设施融资可能可以进行交易。

title: Goldman Stock Pops On $70 Bil Heap Of Fresh Asset Management Deals
title_zh: 高盛股价因 700 亿美元的新资产管理交易而上涨
summary: Goldman stock rose 4.1% Thursday on fresh deals, contributing to the Dow Jones Industrial Average's uptick.
summary_zh: 高盛股价周四因新交易上涨 4.1%，推动道琼斯工业平均指数上涨。

title: Update: Market Chatter: Qiagen Attracts Early Takeover Interest From EQT, Advent, KKR
title_zh: 更新：市场热议：Qiagen 吸引了 EQT、Advent、KKR 的早期收购兴趣
summary: (Updates with Qiagen's response in the last paragraph.) Qiagen (QGEN) is attracting early takeove
summary_zh: （更新了最后一段中 Qiagen 的回应。）Qiagen (QGEN) 正在吸引早期收购

title: Goldman Sachs wins $70 billion retirement asset management deals
title_zh: 高盛赢得 700 亿美元退休资产管理交易
summary: The mandates include $30 billion in pension assets and $40 billion in Verizon defined-contribution retirement assets
summary_zh: 这些授权包括 300 亿美元的养老金资产和 400 亿美元的 Verizon 固定缴款退休资产
